title: Top K Contributers per Country
scenario: For each country, identify transactions that contribute to the top 50% of the total revenue. Return 'id', 'country', and 'amount'.
tableSchema: transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE)
hint: Calculate running sum of amounts per country and total sum per country, then filter where running sum / total sum <= 0.5.
correctQuery: SELECT id, country, amount FROM (SELECT id, country, amount, SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY country ORDER BY amount DESC) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY country) AS ratio FROM transactions) t WHERE ratio <= 0.5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (1, 'US', 'approved', 1000, '2026-01-01'), (2, 'US', 'approved', 500, '2026-01-02'), (3, 'US', 'approved', 100, '2026-01-03');
